name: What is the difference between ground-up construction and a major renovation?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between ground-up construction and a major renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ground-up construction involves building a completely new structure from a cleared site, offering total control over design, layout, and systems from inception. A major renovation, conversely, modifies an existing structure, often retaining its original foundation and some structural elements. While renovations can significantly update a home, they are often limited by the existing footprint and structural constraints. Ground-up provides the ultimate opportunity for customization without inherited issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ground-up construction builds a new home from scratch, offering complete design freedom, while major renovation modifies an existing structure within its original framework.
